v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Vide, Dómine, * et consídera, quóniam tríbulor: velóciter exáudi me.
text.en: Behold, O Lord, and see, * for I am in trouble; hear me speedily.

text.la: Discérne causam meam, * Dómine: ab hómine iníquo et dolóso éripe me.
text.en: Plead my cause, * O Lord; deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.

text.la: Dum tribulárer, * clamávi ad Dóminum de ventre ínferi, et exaudívit me.
text.en: I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, * and He heard me out of the belly of hell.

text.la: Dómine, vim pátior, * respónde pro me: quia néscio quid dicam inimícis meis.
text.en: O Lord, I am oppressed, * undertake Thou for me; for I know not what to say unto mine enemies.

text.la: Dixérunt ímpii: * Opprimámus virum iustum, quóniam contrárius est opéribus nostris.
text.en: The ungodly said Let us oppress the righteous man, * because he is clean contrary to our doings.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Ante diem festum * Paschæ, sciens Iesus quia venit hora eius, cum dilexísset suos, in finem diléxit eos.
text.en: Now, before the Feast of the Passover, as Jesus knew that His hour was come, * having loved His Own which were in the world, He loved them unto the end.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus: da nobis ita Domínicæ passiónis sacraménta perágere; ut indulgéntiam percípere mereámur.
text.en: O Almighty and everlasting God, give us grace so to use the solemn and mysterious memorial of the Lord's Suffering, that the same may be unto us a mean whereby worthily to win thy forgiveness.
